title: CanAreaDamageEvade (spell flag)
html:
CanAreaDamageEvade is a spell flag. It determines whether damage from this spell or action can be evaded with  Evasion or  Shield Master: Block. Despite the descriptions of both features, it does not strictly matter whether an action has a Dexterity saving throw, but whether it has this flag. Generally, this flag is set for actions that deal area of effect damage with a Dexterity saving throw to halve the damage.

There are plenty of exceptions to this rule, however. For example, the action to throw a  Smokepowder Bomb has this flag and can be evaded but the action to shoot a  Smokepowder Arrow does not and is unaffected by Evasion or Shield Master. There are also examples of actions without Dexterity saving throws with this flag such as  Primal Stampede (which uses unarmed attack rolls) or  Frost Breath (which uses a Constitution saving throw). Such actions are affected by Evasion and Shield Master[note 1] despite not involving a Dexterity saving throw.

Notes

List of additional effects with the flag which are not actions in the above table:

  • Fireworks: All
  • Grenades: Many damaging grenades including Acid Vial, Alchemist's Fire, Holy Water, Sanguine Explosive, Smokepowder Bomb/Brilliant Retort, Spiked Bulb/Scrap and Shrapnel Grenade, Concussion Grenade, Orthon Explosive, Orthonic Handbomb, and Surprise-Based Teddy Bear. Notably, poison damage bombs, slime bombs, and void bulb are excluded.
  • Oil of Combustion (Condition)
  • Torchstalk
  • Traps: Most damaging traps

Footnotes

  1. ↑ Shield Master: Block has an additional condition that checks if the damage has a saving throw, so it will not work against actions with CanAreaDamageEvade but no saving throw such as Primal Stampede. It still works against non-Dexterity saving throws.
